BiblicalUsage: The word is distress, travail, trouble on the road. Moses told his father in law all the travail that had befallen Israel by the way, and how the Lord delivered them; Israel told Edom of the travail in the wilderness; and the Levites pray that all the travail that hath come upon their kings and princes and priests be not small before God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the travail on the road is part of the story, and the telling of it is part of the prayer.
